steps.title: Open the home dashboard
steps.narration: We start on Trendora's home dashboard — the daily market snapshot at a glance.
steps.point_out: The Market Regime score and label, and the Market Phase & Severity read, right at the top of the page.

steps.title: Check the dataset's health
steps.narration: The Data Manager page shows exactly what's stored and whether anything still needs catching up.
steps.point_out: Price history range, universe and symbol counts, and any remaining backfill gaps — all read straight from the stored data, never guessed.

steps.title: Open Backtest for the latest date
steps.narration: Backtest lets you time-machine to a past scan date and read its forward-test scorecard — today's (Latest) view stays exactly as fast and unaffected as always.
steps.point_out: The badge names exactly which date you're viewing, with a standing note about survivorship bias always shown alongside the numbers — and the page settles in almost instantly.

steps.title: Read today's scorecard
steps.narration: The Forward-test scorecard reports how the top-ranked stocks from a given date actually performed afterward.
steps.point_out: For this very latest date, every horizon honestly reads a dash — nothing has happened yet to measure, so nothing is invented to fill the gap.

steps.title: See the day's ranked leaders
steps.narration: Leadership cohorts name the top sectors, themes, and individual stocks the scan singled out for this date.
steps.point_out: Top Sectors, Top Themes, and the Ranked cohort table all show real rankings and scores; their forward-return columns stay an honest dash until enough time has passed to measure one.

steps.title: See the accumulated evidence
steps.narration: At the very bottom sits the forward-tested evidence — the track record pooled from every trading day scanned so far, not just today.
steps.point_out: Real accumulated numbers going back through the whole history, plus a guarantee behind the scenes: this section always shows either the freshest complete evidence or a clearly-labeled slightly older set — never a blank message.

steps.title: Time-travel to a date nobody's looked at yet
steps.narration: Opening an older backtest date that's never been viewed before used to freeze the tab for anywhere from several seconds to almost a minute with nothing on screen — it now responds right away.
steps.point_out: The page settles almost instantly and clearly names the historical date you're now viewing — never a blank, frozen tab.

steps.title: An honest note instead of a blank wait
steps.narration: Since this date's own numbers haven't been worked out before, the page says so plainly right away instead of leaving the screen blank or pretending the numbers are already in.
steps.point_out: A calm message explains that viewing this page itself started the calculation in the background, and that reloading shortly will show the finished numbers — no numbers are ever invented in the meantime.
